writer_guide.title: Writer's guide
writer_guide.body:
Lore Editor — chapter writing with a lore panel (characters, ideas, influences, media).

QUICK START
1. Run: lore-editor
2. File → Open… — pick a chapter (.txt / .md).
3. Lore panel (right) → + Character / + Idea / + Influence.
4. Ctrl+S saves chapter and lore together.
5. Media: select an entry → Media menu → Add photo / audio / video.
6. Optional: Ctrl+Shift+D (name dictionary) · F7 (spelling).

LANGUAGE
Menu Language (or LORE_LOCALE=en). See docs/LANGUAGE_PLUGINS.md.

NETWORK
--rpc uses cynober-server (Karmazyn tunnel, not plain HTTP).
Auth: LORE_RPC_USER / LORE_RPC_TOKEN or profile in ~/.karmazyn_client.json.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.body:
FILE
  Ctrl+N           New tab
  Ctrl+O           Open
  Ctrl+S           Save chapter + lore
  Ctrl+Shift+S     Save as…
  Ctrl+W           Close tab
  Ctrl+Shift+O     Project folder…

EDIT
  Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y  Undo / Redo
  Ctrl+F           Find
  Ctrl+Shift+D     Name dictionary
  F7               Spell check

MEDIA (select a lore entry in the panel first)
  Ctrl+Shift+I     Add photo / image
  Ctrl+Shift+U     Add music / audio
  Ctrl+Shift+M     Add video / clip

OTHER
  F1               Help
  Middle-click tab  Close tab

Autosave every 60 s for files already on disk (text + lore).

fonts.title: Fonts and appearance
fonts.body:
Menu: View

DRAFTING — long writing sessions
  Courier New / Courier Prime / Calibri / Arial

PRINT / SUBMISSION
  Garamond · Times New Roman

READABILITY
  OpenDyslexic · Lexend

Size: 11 or 12 pt
Line spacing: 1.5 draft · 1.0 print-ready

Saved in: %USERPROFILE%\.lore_editor\typography.json
Optional fonts: .\scripts\install_fonts.ps1

print.title: Print and export
print.body:
Menu: Print

PAGE PREVIEW
  Screenplay (Courier) — ~1 page ≈ 1 film minute
  Submission manuscript — TNR 12, double spacing
  Print-ready — TNR 12, single spacing

DOCX EXPORT
  Same profiles; requires python-docx (package dependency).
  Check DOCX in Word before publisher submission.

panel.title: Lore panel
panel.body:
Right-hand panel — tabs: Chapter · Search · Team.

Open a chapter before linking lore.

ADD
  + Character · + Idea · + Influence

LINKS
  Link to chapter · Link another entry · Connect to… · Unlink · Edit · Delete

MEDIA (frame at bottom of Chapter tab + menu bar Media)
  + Photo · + Audio · + Video · Attach any file
  Preview · List media · Export to file
  Select an entry first, then attach; set a role (portrait, voice, clip…)
  See topic: Media (photos, audio, video)

OTHER
  Relationship map · Semantic search · Team sync (cynober-server)

media.title: Media (photos, audio, video)
media.body:
Where: menu bar Media · shortcuts · Lore panel → Media frame.

ADD
1. Select a lore entry (character, place, scene…).
2. Media → Add photo / music / video (or + Photo in the panel).
3. Pick a file; set a role (binding): portrait, map, voice, clip…
4. Stored in the .kafd graph as a media atom on the entry bubble.

SHORTCUTS
  Ctrl+Shift+I   photo / image
  Ctrl+Shift+U   music / audio
  Ctrl+Shift+M   video / clip

PREVIEW & EXPORT
  Preview / play…   image window; audio/video via system player
  List entry media  bindings on the entry
  Export…           write media back to disk

FORMATS
  Images: PNG JPEG GIF WebP BMP
  Audio:  WAV MP3 OGG FLAC M4A
  Video:  MP4 WebM MKV MOV

NETWORK (--rpc)
  Needs cynober-server with kafs-stream (cynober-db ≥ 8.2.5).
  Upload: put_media · list: MEDIA LIST · read: get_media.

If no entry is selected, the editor asks you to pick one from the panel list.

spell.title: Dictionary and spelling
spell.body:
F7 checks spelling offline.
• pl — SJP.PL hunspell (bundled)
• en — hunspell en_US if present under lore/data/en_US, else project/lore names + common list

Names from the lore graph are always accepted.

temporal.title: Temporal context
temporal.body:
Character notes/descriptions can differ per chapter (timeline).
Edit entry while a chapter is open to store state for that chapter.
See Polish base topic for full detail if a section is missing.

query.title: Semantic queries
query.body:
Search tab: semantic or phrase queries over the lore graph.
Examples: characters near Anna · type:Character "ally".
Results can be linked to the current chapter.

history.title: Change history
history.body:
Lore → Create restore point… / Change history…
Snapshots cover lore + chapter files under .lore-history/.
Include that folder in backups.

network.title: Network: Karmazyn and Cynober DB
network.body:
--rpc connects to cynober-server over the Karmazyn tunnel (not plain HTTP).
Port 8080 is the secure server, not a REST API.

Auth: non-loopback hosts need user+token (LORE_RPC_USER / LORE_RPC_TOKEN or Team panel).
Media over the wire needs kafs-stream (cynober-db ≥ 8.2.5).
Prefer ≥ 8.2.5 (8.2.4 wheel was broken: missing cynober_paths).

Chapters stay local; the lore graph (+ optional media) goes over the network.
